tasks.goal: The seam between what the platform measures and what the engine consumes: DISC graph choice, competency name→id, LIA percentile tails, personality poles. Four silent defects live here.
tasks.notes: Red first (commit 1050d707: naive adapters, 29/42 tests fail on the defect symptom), then the fix. DiscGraphChoice explicit, default graph 1 (legacy /careers/score's) and recorded; competency names joined NORMALISED (NFD, marks stripped, case-folded, punctuation collapsed), unknown recorded, missing ids → level 0 with a warning; LIA 0/100 → 1/99 with a warning, a missing subtest fails closed; personality poles from the stored counts (winner = 100·count/answered), intensity fallback, 0/0 → 50/50. InputQuality is the audit record the orchestrator persists. 360 is NoDataV360Adapter until FM-CF-006/007.

tasks.goal: Variable-level aggregation with consensus, coverage and confidence (VocationalScoring aggregates at dimension level today).
validation: F04/F05 parity with the reference engine
tasks.notes: Red first (commit e2548aee: naive aggregation, 12/22 tests fail on the defect symptom), then the fix. V360Aggregation: per source per variable the mean of F01-normalized answers -> F02/F03/F04 IntegrateSources over weights.v360_sources -> F05 Confidence360; the aggregate map is produced in the rule set's DECLARED variable order. Coverage is the reference's (sum of rater-source weights, what F05 consumes); ITEM coverage is recorded separately on a per-variable audit and warned on, because the two fail differently. V1 is SELF-ONLY, so consensus degenerates: one rater -> consensus None, confidence index null, global NOT_DETERMINABLE, warning V360_SINGLE_RATER -- no spread is manufactured. The global confidence is F05 applied once at instrument level (the GLOBAL arm of open question 7; F06's relevance-weighted index is the other arm and already ships beside it). Reads go through VocationalResponseLoader, VocationalWriter.LoadGroupsAsync lifted verbatim so there is ONE query for 'the student's 360 responses'; the variable code is read from vocational_responses.dimensionKey and, if FM-CF-006 seeds it elsewhere, NOTHING matches and the run degrades to NO_DATA rather than scoring something wrong. NoData stays the fallback and the selection is explicit (a named delegation, not an empty query): no rater group, or no response carrying a rules.v360_variables code, yields the empty map / NOT_DETERMINABLE / careerfit360 0.0 run of today. DI now registers VocationalV360Adapter; behaviour is unchanged until the items exist.

tasks.goal: CareerFit360 per-family relevance weighting (F06) from rules.families[].v360_rules; IND excluded in V1.
validation: F06 parity; base_weight carried on the rule, not the schema gap
tasks.notes: F06 parity at 1e-9 over six synthetic aggregate sets x 14 families, per-variable combined_weight included: the weight is base_weight x relevance READ OFF THE RULE (rules.families[].v360_rules[code].base_weight, required by the loader since FM-CF-004), pinned by a test that perturbs the rule and watches the catalogue entry stay put, and by one that shows the same variable weighing differently in two families (IND relevance 3 in family 4, 2 in family 1). IND is EXCLUDED in V1 as a NAMED exclusion (V360Aggregation.ExcludedInV1) at the point the evidence is read, not a silent filter: P36 is a 20-industry selection vector and a per-family scalar needs an industry -> family projection TIMS has not delivered; the exclusion is recorded on every run (V360_IND_EXCLUDED) and a test proves removing IND still leaves every scorable family with weighted BASE rules. The rule set is untouched -- when the projection arrives, deleting the exclusion is the whole change. P35 (RANK) is NOT decided here (open question 5): it is recognised, recorded as not scored, and its weight is entirely the rule set's -- base_weight 0 in the catalogue and no family rule in 1.0.0-draft.1, so it contributes nothing today.

tasks.goal: RulesResolver: deep-merge family → subfamily → career, then assert_no_unresolved_markers(). Highest leverage in the plan.
tasks.notes: CareerFitRulesResolver.Check/Resolve: mc_gate.py check_resolved() ported one for one (every problem listed, none truncated), the self-test poisons rejected with family and field named; the fourth poison (one family's 360 row everywhere) is RESOLVED by construction and is the Monte Carlo gate's to catch.
